title: Most Stones Removed with Same Row or Column
goal: Remove as many stones as possible while every removed stone shares a row or column with another remaining stone.
strategy: Union stones sharing a row or a column. Each connected component can be reduced to one stone by removing leaves of a spanning tree, but its final stone cannot be removed.
